name: Flørist, André Cascais, Mimi (Free Entry)
description: This event features performances by Flørist, André Cascais, and Mimi at Gare Porto. Entry to the event is free.
longDescription:
Flørist, André Cascais, and Mimi are scheduled to perform at Gare Porto. The event takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, starting at 11:00 PM and running until 6:00 AM.

Gare Porto is located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal. The event offers free entry for all attendees.
